description: Replace broken Sharell AI chat system with OwnerRez-ready backend. Delete broken code, create mock availability/inquiry APIs, simplify InquiryForm.

stories.title: Delete broken chat API and components
acceptanceCriteria: No imports of SharellChat or useSharellChat remain in codebase
stories.notes: Start with the chat system which is the most broken. Check InquiryForm.tsx for chat imports.

stories.title: Delete broken payment and unused API routes
stories.notes: These routes have security vulnerabilities and are unused.

stories.title: Remove Anthropic SDK and clean lib files
stories.notes: The calendar-sync.ts will be replaced. sharell-prompt.ts and booking-context.ts were for AI chat.

stories.title: Create mock OwnerRez availability API
acceptanceCriteria: Response format: { blockedDates: string[], lastUpdated: string }
Mock data includes some realistic blocked date ranges
stories.notes: No real API credentials yet. Mock realistic data. Keep same response format the frontend expects.

stories.title: Create inquiry submission API route
acceptanceCriteria: POST endpoint accepts: name, email, guests, checkIn, checkOut, addOns, message
Validates required fields (name, email, checkIn, checkOut)
Returns { success: true, inquiryId: string, message: string }
Logs inquiry data to console (placeholder for OwnerRez)
stories.notes: Placeholder for OwnerRez guest/quote creation. Structure ready for real API integration later.

stories.title: Simplify InquiryForm - remove chat, add thank you state
acceptanceCriteria: All SharellChat/chat modal imports and code removed
Success state shows thank you message in-form (no modal)
Error handling shows user-friendly error message
stories.notes: Keep existing form fields (dates, guests, add-ons). Remove all chat modal logic. Show confirmation inline.

stories.title: Final verification and cleanup
acceptanceCriteria: No references to deleted files remain
stories.notes: Final sweep for any remaining issues. Check for dangling imports or references.
